body:
Coupled SHIFT_STEP drives MOSI and samples synchronized RX on the same execution edge. The retained public-pin counterexample fails the declared mode-0 response envelope. This draft compares phase-separated encodings and qualifies the compact experimental candidate through its actual public loader and result-store/reset boundary, while keeping production RTL unchanged.

- E0020 freezes a partial mode-0 contract, independent pin oracle and failing traces. The eight-word coupled schedule reads 0xb4 instead of 0x69 despite 55 ns target setup; a faster-target/no-RTL option remains conditional.
- E0021 compares complete-chip generic costs: baseline 2,793 cells/410 state bits; compact eight-word candidate 3,107/412; ten-word banked candidate 3,403/477. Both phase variants pass 519 public transfers per simulator. Compact preserves all17 legacy groups; banked retains its declared length-nine compatibility failure.
- E0022 proves written executor phase rules and legacy-only refinement, with10+3 covers and two retained expected mutant failures.
- E0023 adds the actual compact top, full256-bit program store, data registers and two-stage synchronizer. Written integration safety passes induction with only initial chip reset; bounded public-loaded completion/abort witnesses and four groups on each simulator check capture, all40 abort cuts, old-result lifetime and reset/readback. Loader entry preserves an older completed RX/valid; payload writes invalidate valid only; chip reset erases storage.

Current head: `0b0409ea4078a997a0a487f36ebfac286d5d46a7`.

Validation at this head: doctor and make check PASS (35 reference/provenance cases); atlas export consistency PASS; all7 integration formal jobs achieve required outcomes; Icarus/Verilator each4/4 PASS. Integration prove depth8 succeeds at induction step5 with base0..7; public completion BMC80 checks through79; guided final-capture-edge41 abort BMC72 checks through71;4+4 covers reached. Wrong loader-clears-valid claim and disconnected-store-write mutant retain expected FAIL witnesses at67/62. Per simulator:512 completed transfers,480 fresh aborts,48 older-result abort cases and reset/readback group.

The wider guided symbolic abort cut2..41 timed out at300s and remains a failure record, not a pass through40. Final guided formal cut is explicitly41; universal safety still permits arbitrary public changes and simulation covers all40cuts. The initial simulation fixture error is retained. No experimental candidate fix was warranted.

All five exact-head workflows completed successfully: [test push](https://github.com/KG-khangelani/protocol-emulator-asic/actions/runs/41713013583), [test PR](https://github.com/KG-khangelani/protocol-emulator-asic/actions/runs/41713023661), [atlas push](https://github.com/KG-khangelani/protocol-emulator-asic/actions/runs/41713013681), [atlas PR](https://github.com/KG-khangelani/protocol-emulator-asic/actions/runs/41713023728), and [docs](https://github.com/KG-khangelani/protocol-emulator-asic/actions/runs/41713013886).

Both verification ZIPs were independently audited in memory. Digests and byte counts match GitHub; committed-source hashes, generated inputs and the local reviewed integration model match; the collector's11 stages and every retained-artifact checksum pass. Production JUnit has19 cases per simulator plus1 GL-shaped and1 learning case, without failures/skips. All12 comparison stages, declared banked compatibility failure and independently recomputed generic netlist counts match. The6 core formal and7 integration jobs meet their required outcomes, including expected failures, exact covers and raw counterexamples. Each simulator passes4 integration groups.

- Push artifact [13268784020](https://github.com/KG-khangelani/protocol-emulator-asic/actions/runs/41713013583/artifacts/13268784020):2,158,516 bytes; SHA256 `ebdd3e4a4c143130a904bc5b6c99d984f38b227e6fcabdcb46ccac63c364eb02`; clean checkout `0b0409ea4078a997a0a487f36ebfac286d5d46a7`.
- PR artifact [13270001683](https://github.com/KG-khangelani/protocol-emulator-asic/actions/runs/41713023661/artifacts/13270001683):2,157,570 bytes; SHA256 `17b3fd5e0bb884360e35174562bec160fc36a7da0fffe1ceaa26a4f60f1e36c5`; clean synthetic-merge checkout `12b6eb63532bcf270947f68c17c829e0d302c182`. This temporary CI checkout is not a merge into main.

The raw integration witnesses confirm valid remains1 after loader read at public cycle66; the dropped-store mutant emits an engine completion at61 but misses the store commit at62. Candidate/production sources remain identical to the reviewed prior candidate. [E0023](https://github.com/KG-khangelani/protocol-emulator-asic/blob/0b0409ea4078a997a0a487f36ebfac286d5d46a7/evidence/E0023-compact-public-integration/README.md) retains the frozen local evidence and initial failures. Prior checkpoint284c9cc terminal CI/digests are preserved in E0023/pr11-prior-checkpoint.json.

Reproduce in the existing locked workbench:
```sh
python3 experiments/spi_phase/run_comparison.py
python3 experiments/spi_phase/run_formal.py
python3 experiments/spi_phase/run_integration.py --with-simulation
```

Contracts: docs/specs/p-spi-host-mode0.md, spi-phase-comparison.md, spi-phase-formal.md and spi-phase-integration.md. Decisions D21–D24 and evidence E0020–E0023 retain hashes, configurations, exact outcomes and counterexamples.

This remains partial digital simulation/formal/generic evidence. It does not establish all-four-mode SPI, physical input timing, CMOS5L area/slack, Fmax, silicon, arbitrary-program termination, minimum-state claims or H1–H4. Production src/config/interface, visualizer and learning record are unchanged. PR8/compiler remain deferred; owner M0 fluency PENDING. Keep draft/unmerged. Next: qualify the eight-word mode-0 program end to end under explicit external-pin timing assumptions.
